Filler (Juvederm, Restylane, various other products)

These types of injections are made directly into the skin, and work by restoring volume and reshaping the skin. There are many fillers on the market today. We will help you find the optimal product or combination that can give you the look you will want and love. The filler can be used in many places on the face, including the nose for a "non-surgical rhinoplasty" type of procedure.

Book Consultation

Wrinkle Relaxer (Botox, Jeuveau, Dysport, Xeomin)

These types of injectable medications work by signaling the muscles underneath lines and wrinkles to relax. This has the effect of smoothing the skin and lessens wrinkles and lines. We use straightforward injections with very small needles. This is a minimally invasive procedure. Patient experience minimal pain and there is virtually no downtime.

Book Consultation

Mole or Skin Tag Removal

Unwanted moles and skin tags are no longer something you have to live with. We remove them safely and precisely right here in our office using a simple in-office procedure performed under local anesthesia. The process is quick, virtually painless, and leaves you with the cleanest result possible — because when it comes to your face and body, the details matter.

Book Consultation

Skin Lesion Biopsy and Excision

If you have a suspicious or concerning growth on your skin, getting it evaluated and properly removed is the most important step you can take. We perform skin lesion biopsies and excisions in-office with precision and care, ensuring the area is thoroughly examined and removed cleanly. Your health and peace of mind come first — and we make sure the result looks as good as it feels.

Book Consultation

Split Earlobe Repair

Whether your earlobe has torn from heavy earrings, an accidental pull, or years of wear, we can restore it to a smooth, natural appearance. Split earlobe repair is a minor in-office procedure performed under local anesthesia that takes less than an hour. Most patients walk out the same day and are fully healed within a few weeks — with results that look completely natural.

Book Consultation

Earlobe Reduction

Over time, earlobes can stretch, sag, or become disproportionately large — whether from aging, genetics, or years of wearing heavy jewelry. Earlobe reduction is a simple in-office procedure that reshapes and resizes the earlobe to better complement your facial features. It's a small change that makes a noticeable difference, and recovery is minimal.

Book Consultation

Laser Resurfacing

Laser resurfacing uses controlled energy to remove damaged skin layers and stimulate collagen, effectively treating fine lines, scarring, and pigmentation. Our diverse technology - including CO2, Erbium, and Q-Switch lasers - allows for everything from light treatments with minimal downtime to deeper rejuvenation. Beyond resurfacing, we utilize specialized lasers to treat vascular lesions, remove unwanted hair, and clear tattoos, with full results appearing over several months as collagen remodels.

Book Consultation

Earlobe Gauge Repair

If you've stretched your earlobes with gauges and are ready to restore their natural appearance, we can help. Earlobe gauge repair is a specialized in-office procedure that reconstructs the earlobe, closing the stretched opening and reshaping the tissue to look as natural as possible. Results are permanent, and most patients are back to their normal routine the same day.

Book Consultation

PRP Treatments

Platelet-Rich Plasma (PRP) therapy uses your body’s own growth factors to rejuvenate skin and improve tone, texture, and overall quality. After a small blood draw, the concentrated plasma is injected into targeted areas to stimulate collagen production and tissue repair. PRP can improve fine lines, skin dullness, and overall skin vitality. There is minimal downtime. Results: Gradual improvement over several weeks, with optimal results after a series of treatments.

Book Consultation

IPL (Intense Pulsed Light)

Intense Pulsed Light (IPL) is a non-invasive skin treatment that uses broad-spectrum light energy to target pigmentation, sun damage, redness, and broken capillaries. The light energy penetrates the skin to reduce discoloration and stimulate collagen production, resulting in a clearer, more even complexion. IPL is commonly used on the face, neck, chest, and hands. The procedure involves minimal discomfort and little to no downtime, with mild redness that typically resolves within a day. A series of treatments is often recommended for optimal results. Results: Gradual improvement in skin tone and clarity over several weeks.

Book Consultation

Microneedling Resurfacing

Microneedling resurfacing uses fine needles to create controlled micro-injuries in the skin, stimulating natural collagen and elastin production. This treatment improves fine lines, acne scars, enlarged pores, and overall skin texture. It is minimally invasive with mild redness lasting one to three days. Results: Gradual improvement over several weeks, with optimal results after a series of treatments.
